content.description:
As our Product Operations Manager, you will report to the Head of Product Operations and play an important role in improving how our Product Development organization plans, collaborates, and delivers. Working closely with Product, Engineering, and Design teams, you will help strengthen roadmap planning and execution, advance Product Development Lifecycle (PDLC) practices, and drive meaningful operational improvements. You will bring a proactive, data-informed approach to identifying challenges, uncovering opportunities, and leading cross-functional initiatives that help teams make better decisions and operate more effectively. This is a hands-on role for an experienced Product Operations professional who enjoys solving operational challenges and helping teams deliver customer and business value.

- This position will be hybrid based out of our Lehi, UT HQ (3x per week)

- If outside of UT, periodic travel will be required to our Lehi, UT HQ.

- Reports to: Head of Product Operations

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

- Partner with Product and Engineering teams to strengthen quarterly roadmap planning, readiness, capacity visibility, and alignment on priorities.

- Facilitate planning and execution across assigned teams, clarifying ownership, milestones, and dependencies while proactively addressing risks and blockers.

- Independently lead assigned cross-functional initiatives, driving stakeholder alignment, accountability, and progress from planning through delivery.

- Partner with Product and Engineering Managers to improve dependency management, delivery forecasting, and alignment between product priorities and engineering constraints.

- Strengthen adoption of Product Development Lifecycle (PDLC) practices, standards, and ways of working to improve consistency and execution.

- Support product release and launch coordination, ensuring cross-functional readiness, clear ownership, and alignment with business stakeholders.

- Maintain and improve operational reporting and dashboards, translating performance data and stakeholder feedback into actionable insights and recommendations.

- Identify and implement improvements to Product Development processes, operating rhythms, and tools that reduce friction and improve effectiveness.

- Develop and refine Product Operations playbooks, templates, and best practices, providing practical guidance to support team adoption.opportunities for continuous improvement that strengthen Product Development effectiveness.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED TO ACCOMPLISH THE JOB

- 3–5+ years of experience in Product Operations, Technical Program Management, Product Management, Engineering, or a related discipline within a SaaS or technology company.

- Demonstrated experience supporting roadmap planning and execution across Product and Engineering teams, including prioritization, capacity planning, and dependency management.

- Experience independently leading cross-functional product development initiatives, coordinating stakeholders, managing dependencies, and addressing execution risks.

- Experience improving operational processes, frameworks, and ways of working within Product Development organizations.

- Strong working knowledge of modern software development practices, methodologies, and lifecycles.

- Technical fluency with product development tools such as Linear or Jira and analytics platforms, with an understanding of engineering and delivery metrics.

- Strong analytical skills with experience developing operational reporting, interpreting performance data, and translating findings into actionable recommendations.

- Strong business acumen with the ability to connect operational improvements to delivery effectiveness, customer value, and business outcomes.

- Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build alignment across Product, Engineering, and business teams.

- Demonstrated ability to work independently, navigate ambiguity, identify operational challenges, and drive practical improvements.

WHAT WILL MAKE US LOVE YOU

- You are a self-starter who takes ownership of responsibilities and proactively addresses challenges.

- You have firsthand experience working with Product and Engineering teams and understand the realities of software development and delivery.

- You naturally identify gaps, connect information, and bring forward practical recommendations.

- You build trusted relationships through collaboration, communication, and follow-through.

- You balance operational structure with flexibility, improving how teams work without introducing unnecessary complexity.

- You are analytical and curious, using data and feedback to identify opportunities others may miss.

- You are highly organized and comfortable managing multiple priorities, stakeholders, and initiatives.

- You are energized by solving operational challenges and helping teams work more effectively together.

Employment with Weave is contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, conducted in accordance with applicable laws.

At Weave, we use Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools to help us work more efficiently and create a smoother candidate experience. AI may assist with things like writing job descriptions, scheduling interviews, or reviewing applications against job-related criteria. For additional information, please review the External AI Policy Statement available on our Careers page.

Weave is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all individuals are valued and supported. We welcome anyone who is hungry to learn, problem-solve and progress regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

Beware of recruitment fraud. All official correspondence will occur through Weave branded email. We will never ask you to share bank account information, cash a check from us, or purchase software or equipment as part of your interview or hiring process.
